c.title: $6,000 / 2br - Coal Harbour 2 Bed / 2 Bath with Parking — $5,200 — Nov 15
c.description:
Come home to light, space and Coal Harbour living at Palais Georgia, 501–1415 W Georgia Street.
Large windows brighten the living and dining areas, with glimpses toward the water and North Shore mountains. Dark flooring adds warmth throughout, and the balcony gives you a place to step outside and take in the neighbourhood.
The window-lined kitchen has white cabinetry, stone counters, a gas cooktop and wall ovens. The home offers two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a walk-in closet and one parking space. Building features include an indoor pool, exercise centre, sauna/steam room, hot tub and elevator.
Rent: $5,200 per month
Available: November 15, 2026
Lease: Minimum one year
No pets. Utilities paid separately.
For a viewing, contact David Siccia of Heller Murch Realty at show contact info or show contact info . More about David: davidsicciaproperties.ca.
